text_block_list.text:
One day after the Tenno Sho, Mejiro 
McQueen was personally entrusted by her 
"Grandmother" to show a new path forward 
for the Mejiro family.

Caught completely off guard, Mejiro 
McQueen struggles to process her feelings. 
Mejiro Ryan offers her words of 
encouragement—

Furthermore, wishing to become "strong" 
just like Mejiro McQueen... she challenges 
her to a duel once again.

Witnessing her resolve, Mejiro McQueen 
wished to demonstrate her own "resolve to 
carry the Mejiro name" and accepted the 
challenge for the Takarazuka Kinen.
